You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

To make a funnel cake without a funnel, here are the steps needed.

Step 2. Whisk the egg until frothy (3 minutes)
Step 3. Combine wet and dry ingredients slowly (5 minutes)
Step 4. Sift the all-purpose flour into a bowl (4 minutes)
Step 5. Microwave the milk slightly to take off the chill (30 seconds)
Step 6. Check the oil temperature with a thermometer (1 minute)
Step 7. Add a pinch of salt to the flour mixture (30 seconds)
Step 8. Clear a space on the counter for the cooling rack (2 minutes)

Step 11. Stir the batter until mostly smooth (4 minutes)

Step 51. Prepare a bowl of ice water just in case (2 minutes)
Step 52. Squeeze the batter in a circular motion into the oil (2 minutes)
Step 53. Add the melted butter to the batter (1 minute)
Step 54. Fry the first side until golden brown (3 minutes)
Step 55. Crack the egg into a small ramekin (30 seconds)
Step 56. Wipe down the countertop (5 minutes)
Step 57. Whisk the baking powder into the flour (1 minute)
Step 58. Flip the funnel cake carefully (30 seconds)
Step 59. Fry the second side until crispy (2 minutes)
Step 60. Monitor the oil temperature constantly (10 minutes)
Step 61. Set a timer for the frying process (15 seconds)
Step 62. Lay out a cooling rack (1 minute)
Step 63. Let the batter rest to relax the gluten (10 minutes)
Step 64. Zero out the kitchen scale (10 seconds)
Step 65. Remove the cake from the hot oil (30 seconds)
Step 66. Wait for the oil to return to temperature (4 minutes)
Step 67. Drain the excess oil over the pot (30 seconds)
Step 68. Put on an apron (1 minute)
Step 69. Sift the powdered sugar over the warm cake (1 minute)
Step 70. Put away the milk and eggs (2 minutes)
Step 71. Clear the sink of dirty dishes (10 minutes)
Step 72. Find the tongs (1 minute)
Step 73. Prepare a landing station for the finished cake (2 minutes)
Step 74. Place the cake on the paper towels (30 seconds)
Step 75. Gather all the topping ingredients (3 minutes)
Step 76. Wash the whisk (2 minutes)
Step 77. Check that the stovetop is clean (2 minutes)
Step 78. Adjust the flame height (30 seconds)
Step 79. Dust with a second layer of powdered sugar (30 seconds)
Step 80. Clean the rim of the batter bowl (1 minute)
Step 81. Turn off the stove burner (10 seconds)
Step 82. Hold the bag firmly to prevent leaks (1 minute)
Step 83. Position the bag over the center of the pot (20 seconds)
Step 84. Inspect the cake for even browning (30 seconds)
Step 85. Measure the vanilla extract (1 minute)
Step 86. Mix the cinnamon and sugar for the topping (2 minutes)
Step 87. Tie back long hair (30 seconds)
Step 88. Scrape the sides of the bowl with a spatula (1 minute)
Step 89. Rinse the measuring cups (2 minutes)
Step 90. Pull out the frying pot (1 minute)
Step 91. Squeeze out the very last bit of batter (1 minute)
Step 92. Transfer the cake to a serving plate (30 seconds)
Step 93. Allow the cake to cool for a moment (2 minutes)
Step 94. Check the kitchen for any missing tools (5 minutes)
Step 95. Measure the nutmeg (1 minute)
Step 96. Take a photo of the finished funnel cake (1 minute)
Step 97. Put the flour container back in the pantry (1 minute)
Step 98. Discard the used plastic bag (30 seconds)
Step 99. Wash the sifter (3 minutes)
Step 100. Serve the funnel cake while hot (1 minute)
